programme.title: Η ΜΑΣΑ ΚΑΙ Ο ΑΡΚΟΥΔΟΣ (MASHA AND THE BEAR)
Η ΤΡΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΤΟ ΒΑΣΙΛΕΙΟ ΤΟΥ ΟΥΡΑΝΙΟΥ ΤΟΞΟΥ (TRUE AND THE RAINBOW KINGDOM)
Η DC ΛΕΓΕΩΝΑ ΑΠΟ ΤΑ ΣΟΥΠΕΡ-ΚΑΤΟΙΚΙΔΙΑ (DC LEAGUE OF SUPER PETS)
Ο ΓΚΡΙΖΙ ΚΑΙ ΤΑ ΛΕΜΙΝΓΚΣ (GRIZZY & THE LEMMINGS)
Ο ΑΛΒΙΝ ΚΑΙ Η ΠΑΡΕΑ ΤΟΥ (ALVIN!!! AND THE CHIPMUNKS)
David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Ballet Jörgen de Canada
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin. He previously wrote the scores for two of Canada's Ballet Jörgen's most popular ballets: The Velveteen Rabbit and The Emperor's New Clothes. Anastasia is both the tragic story of an innocent young girl and a modern myth: the exact events of that fateful summer of 1918 are shrouded in the mists of time. The ballet explores this lovable yet controversial main character's emotions, aspirations, and affections, as she is faced with a world in turmoil that undergoes an inevitable transformation. Anastasia is a sumptuous ballet performance, where costume and set design as well as the exquisite stage lighting reveal Canada's Ballet Jörgen's dedication to creative quality.

programme.title: Julie Berthollet
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.

programme.title: Simone Lamsma, Gianandrea Noseda & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek. The composer initially intended to dedicate the piece to the young Kotek, but eventually dedicated it to another violinist, Leopold Auer, as he was afraid of the gossip the dedication would cause. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on April 10, 2022.

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova, Juliane Banse, Emmanuel Pahud & Claudio Bohorquez
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur. In this concert at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. The program opens with Mendelssohn's Piano Trio in D minor, Op. 49. This is followed by a selection of songs: Mendelssohn's Schilflied ‘Auf dem Teich, dem regungslosen', Op. 71 No. 4, and Reiselied ‘Der Herbstwind rüttelt die Bäume', Op. 34 No. 6 Hensel's Vorwurf, Op. 10 No. 2 Verlust, Op. 9 No. 10 and Sehnsucht, Op. 9 No. 7 Mendelssohn's ‘Allnächtlich im Traume seh ich dich', Op. 86 No. 4 ‘Die Liebende schreibt', Op. 86 No. 3 and Nachtlied ‘Vergangen ist der lichte Tag', Op. 71 No. 6. The program continues with Mendelssohn's Seven Songs without Words, for piano four-hands (Op. 62 Nos. 1-6, and Op. 67 No. 1), and comes to a close with Mendelssohn's Three pieces for clarinet, violoncello and piano (arr. Ernst Naumann), comprising Prelude, Op. 35 No. 4, Songs without Words, Op. 53 No. 2, and Duet, Op. 38 No. 6. This performance was recorded in November 2020.

programme.title: David Radzynski, Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Sir John Eliot Gardiner & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival's 2021 edition, Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, ‘Little Russian', and Edward Elgar's Variations on an Original Theme, Op. 36, better known as the Enigma Variations. Written in 1872, Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 bears the nickname ‘Little Russian', as the composer used folk tunes in his work from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia'. Completed in 1899, Elgar's Enigma Variations is an orchestral work comprising a theme and fourteen variations, each variation being a musical sketch of one of the composer's friends. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Eduard Topchjan & Armenian Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer's unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. Berlioz used one melody in each movement of the work representing the artist's beloved, an ‘idée fixe' (a fixed idea or obsession). The work is scored for a large orchestra and features an astonishing array of instrumental colors, including church bells, an off-stage oboe, and strings playing col legno (using the wood of their bow). This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.sub-title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last completely instrumental piece in 1791. Clarinet Concerto in A Major was written for his friend Anton Stadler, who gave the first performance of it in Prague to a great reception according to the Berlin Musikalisches Wochenblatt. Today, a major part of the first movement is often used in auditions for orchestras and music schools. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts. Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt is the featured soloist.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg, Kristoffer Appel & Isabel Schwartzbach
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S. Bach's celebrated Goldberg Variations, BWV 988. Completed in 1741, the work is named after German harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, who might have been the first to have performed the work. Bach's masterpiece consists of an aria and a set of thirty variations. Rather than writing variations on the aria's melody, Bach used the accompanying bass line as his starting point. This performance was recorded at Theater Carlo Felice in Genoa, Italy, on April 13, 2015.

programme.title: Martha Argerich
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg, Kristoffer Appel & Isabel Schwartzbach
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Ballet Jörgen de Canada
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin. He previously wrote the scores for two of Canada's Ballet Jörgen's most popular ballets: The Velveteen Rabbit and The Emperor's New Clothes. Anastasia is both the tragic story of an innocent young girl and a modern myth: the exact events of that fateful summer of 1918 are shrouded in the mists of time. The ballet explores this lovable yet controversial main character's emotions, aspirations, and affections, as she is faced with a world in turmoil that undergoes an inevitable transformation. Anastasia is a sumptuous ballet performance, where costume and set design as well as the exquisite stage lighting reveal Canada's Ballet Jörgen's dedication to creative quality.

programme.title: Silas Bjerregard, Clara Cecilie Thomsen, eee gee & Caspar Phillipson
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history. These are famous soundtracks that, for nearly a century, have made us shiver, melt, and cry in the darkness of the cinema. Christian Schumann conducts The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir and soloists are Silas Bjerregaard and eee gee with host Caspar Phillipson as special guest.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto, Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Ruxandra Donose & Ramón Vargas
programme.sub-title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler's song-symphony — one of the composer's most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Beatrice Rana, Gianandrea Noseda & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, famously known as the ‘Emperor' Concerto. Italian pianist Beatrice Rana features as the soloist here. The New York Times describes her as ‘one of the most insightful and prodigiously gifted artists of the new generation'. Beethoven's Fifth Piano Concerto opens with a grand, majestic chord followed by a brilliant flourish from the piano, setting the tone for one of the most celebrated works in the piano repertoire. Composed between 1809 and 1811, it reflects Beethoven's heroic spirit during a turbulent period in European history and is admired for its boldness, lyricism, and virtuosic demands. This concert was recorded at London's Barbican Hall, UK, on February 2, 2022.

programme.title: Sarah Hicks, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir & Tuva Semmingsen
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone's iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono, and Bernard Herrmann. Soloists for this performance are Tuva Semmingsen (mezzo), Christine Nonbo Andersen (soprano), Hans Ulrik (saxophone) and Mads Kjølby (guitars). Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark in 2018.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No. 44 in E-minor, Vivier´s Lonely Child', Ligeti´s 'Lontano' and Death and Transfiguration by Richard Strauss.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg & Avery Amereau
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: David Radzynski, Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: National Opera Oslo, Marita Sølberg, Diego Torre & Vasily Ladyuk
programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo. About his choice for this updated version, Herheim explained: “In bringing La bohème into a present-day setting with this new production we hope to revive the immediate power of suggestion and importance that this work at one time revelled in.” The opera about the Bohemian lifestyle of the poor seamstress Mimì and her artist friends is a fast-moving story, and offers some of the greatest arias Puccini ever wrote. Norwegian conductor Eivind Gullberg Jensen leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the National Opera Oslo. Among the soloists are Marita Sølberg (Mimì), Diego Torre (Rodolfo), Vasily Ladyuk (Marcello), and Jennifer Rowley (Musetta).

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.sub-title: The Post: los oscuros secretos del Pentágono; Bright; 12 Valientes
programme.desc: Actores y cineastas visionarios comparten detalles y aspectos memorables durante la creación de cada película.

programme.title: Santa Tell Me
programme.desc: Una presentadora de un programa de diseño encuentra una carta de Santa prometiéndole conocer a su verdadero amor en Nochebuena, un hombre llamado Nick, pero conocer a tres personas con el mismo nombre complica su búsqueda.

programme.title: One Royal Holiday
programme.desc: Anna les ofrece a una madre y su hijo varados refugio de una ventisca, pero se entera de que son la familia real de Galwick y que ambos necesitan un poco de magia navideña.

programme.title: El desfile navideño
programme.desc: Jessica está emocionada por encargarse de la organización del desfile navideño de su ciudad en Nueva Inglaterra. Cuando la persona encargada de interpretar a Santa se enferma, ella debe encontrar un reemplazo, aunque este no esté dispuesto.

programme.title: Navidad en Alaska
programme.desc: Una organizadora de bodas debe viajar a Alaska para encontrar una flor exótica para un cliente. Allí, conoce un hombre que se ofrece a ayudarla.

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: Jules, de dieciséis años, va en busca de un nuevo amor para su padre, con la esperanza de encontrar a alguien a quien también pueda abrir su corazón.

programme.title: Una Navidad en Biltmore
programme.desc: Un reloj de arena mágico envía a la guionista Lucy Hardgrove al set de la clásica película navideña de 1947 "His Merry Wife!" Sin embargo, antes de poder regresar al presente, Lucy deberá hacer las cosas bien para no alterar el futuro.

programme.title: Concierto de Navidad
programme.desc: Una pianista reconocida mundialmente redescubre su pasión por la música después de reencontrarse con su ex durante las vacaciones.

programme.desc: Lunar Roving Vehicle to jedna z największych ikon programu Apollo. Księżycowy samochód pozwolił astronautom udać się dalej, zbadać więcej niż byli w stanie wcześniej. Nie mógłby jednak powstać, gdyby nie polski naukowiec, Mieczysław Bekker.

programme.title: Ibex - alpejski akrobata
programme.desc: Oto krajobraz górski: lśniące lodowce, strome ściany skalne, głębokie doliny. W oddali maleńka kropka z dwoma gigantycznymi rogami. To królestwo jednego z najbardziej ikonicznych zwierząt szczytów: koziorożca alpejskiego.

programme.title: Rok w ogrodzie
programme.desc: Jesień to czas bylin i traw. O tych dużo się mówi, ale głównie o miskantach czy rozplenicach. Dlatego w programie powiemy o nowościach w tej grupie roślin. Będzie także o tych trawach, które teraz jesienią ładnie się przebarwiają.

programme.title: Rok w ogrodzie Extra
programme.desc: Tym razem zapraszamy na Podkarpacie, w okolice Rzeszowa, gdzie od 4 lat swój ogród tworzy Dawid. Jego ogród jest naturalistyczny, idealny dla osób lubiących porządek wyznaczany przez naturę, ale jednocześnie swobodny, impresjonistyczny.

programme.title: Exclusiv în România
programme.desc: Un serial TV în care fiecare episod urmăreşte prezentarea unei Românii multiculturală şi multietnică, de care românii să fie mândri şi pe care străinii să nu o mai judece prin prisma unor şabloane învechite. Cristian Tabără călătoreşte, descoperă şi prezintă istorie, cultură, credinţă, arhitectură, tradiţii, gastronomie, facilităţi turistice şi, mai ales, unicate europene şi mondiale din România, dintre care unele sunt încă necunoscute şi neexploatate turistic. Emisiunea întâlneşte telespectatorul cu destinaţii spectaculoase, cu povestea şi istoria locului, cu facilităţi locale (acces, cazare, distracţii, costuri), cu trasee de încercat, specific local, gastronomie, tradiţii şi atracţii locale.

programme.desc: Programul „Tezaure Umane Vii” este o inițiativă UNESCO menită să identifice, recunoască și protejeze meșterii și creatorii populari care dețin și transmit mai departe cunoștințe, abilități și tehnici tradiționale pe cale de dispariție In total sunt peste 100 de persoane care detin acest titlu. O parte dintre detinatorii acestui titlu nu mai traiesc, iar multi dintre ei sunt in varsta, asa ca imortalizarea acestora poate fi si un omagiu pe care TVR il aduce acestor creatori de exceptie. Fiecare episod “Nepieritorii “ va fi dedicat unui personaj care detine titlul de “Tezaur Uman Viu UNESCO si va portretiza viata si munca, efortul depus pentru pastrarea mestesugului respectiv. La finalul fiecarui episod, persoana portretizata va transmite si un mesaj dedicat aniversarii a 70 de ani de TVR Emisiunea “Nepieritorii” va fi realizata in cadrul proiectului “TVR-70” si va presupune realizare unor medalioane dedicate acelor persoane care detin titlul de “Tezaur Uman Viu UNESCO”. Este vorba despre acei mestesugari, rapsozi populari, instrumentisti care pastreaza traditiile de secole ale poporului roman. programme.desc: Germania. Pot folosi tehnologia blockchain ? Îmi voi pierde locul de muncă din cauza inteligenţei artificiale? Ce înseamnă Machine Learning ?Deşi echipamentele smart şi algoritmii ne uşurează mult viaţa, datele noastre cu caracter personal au devenit o marfă valoroasă, pe care le-am scăpat de sub control. Internetul oferă posibilităţi nelimitate pentru a ne informa şi a învăţa, dar, în acelaşi timp, trollii şi boţii influenţează formarea opiniei publice.Lumea digitală ne pune zilnic societatea la încercare. Emisiunea magazin îşi propune să ajute utilizatorii să facă alegeri în cunoştinţă de cauză, pentru a evita multiplele riscuri.

programme.title: NAVELE DE RĂZBOI: O SUTĂ DE ANI DE INOVAŢII
programme.desc: Franţa, Documentar. La sfârşitul secolului al XIX-lea, progresele tehnice schimbă din temelii arta bătăliilor navale prin adăugarea de noi componente: de atunci înainte luptele nu s-au mai dus doar pe apă, ci şi în aer şi sub apă. Submarinele şi avioanele au devenit parte integrantă; marea a devenit teatrul unor confruntări complexe.Seria îşi propune să reconstituie istoria bătăliilor navale moderne văzută prin ochii celor care au gândit şi construit aceste arme de război şi ai celor care le-au utilizat.

programme.title: PONEIUL DIN CONNEMARA - O LEGENDĂ IRLANDEZĂ
programme.desc: Franţa-Germania. De generaţii, poneiul din Connemara este foarte iubit în Irlanda. An de an, nenumărate spectacole şi competiţii ecvestre sunt dedicate acestor cabaline, renumite pentru robusteţea şi blândeţea lor.Regiunea Connemara, din vestul Irlandei, este o zonă cu peisaje sălbatice, bătută de vânturi şi cu faleze abrupte. Ea este şi "regatul" poneiului din Connemara - unica rasă indigenă a insulei -, care a cucerit inimile locuitorilor, pentru care este un soi de mascotă.

programme.desc: Fisher es un hombre sin escrúpulos que se ha hecho poderoso en el lugar mediante la estafa, el asesinato y el terror, para así conseguir los terrenos donde extraer oro. Cat y Hutch unen sus fuerzas a la de unos artistas de circo y otros ciudadanos para luchar contra la opresión de Fisher y sus secuaces, dispuestos a no aguantar por más tiempo esta situación. Wéstern italiano protagonizado por la inseparable pareja cinematográfica formada por Terence Hill y Bud Spencer (''Me llamo Trinity''). La cinta tiene pinceladas de humor en algunas de sus escenas, consiguiendo endulzar en cierta manera la crudeza del género del oeste. A pesar de los excelentes resultados en taquilla obtenidos por el filme y la originalidad en el guión por la introducción del mundo del circo en la trama, el trabajo no supo aprovechar sus posibilidades. Entre las malas críticas obtenidas, se acusó al equipo de abusar de los movimientos de cámara.

programme.title: Shalako
programme.desc: Nuevo México, 1880. Un cazador llamado Shalako trabaja como guía para los aristócratas europeos, y les lleva a través de las zonas desérticas y el territorio indio. Nunca ha tenido excesivos problemas en su trabajo, hasta que un día los apaches se enfadan por el mal trato recibido, ya que entre otras cosas los visitantes organizan juegos y expediciones de caza. A partir de entonces, Shalako y su grupo se convertirán en su objetivo. Intento de renovación del género del wéstern a partir del emparejamiento de dos de los mitos eróticos más importantes de la época: Sean Connery y Brigitte Bardot. Coproducida entre España, el Reino Unido y Alemania, la cinta se rodó en Almería, de ahí la presencia de glorias locales como Julián Mateos. Dirigió el norteamericano Edward Dmyrtyk (''Alvarez Kelly''), todo un especialista en el género que hizo con ella uno de sus últimos trabajos para el cine.

programme.title: A veinte millas de la justicia
programme.desc: Una organización mafiosa se dedica a introducir inmigrantes en Estados Unidos, burlando a la policía fronteriza. Un día, cometen un error y asesinan a sangre fría a uno de los guardias. El norteamericano Jerrold Freedman (''Kansas City Bomber'', ''Una fría noche de muerte'') dirige y escribe este drama policíaco que explica la historia de un duro y curtido policía que remueve cielo y tierra para vengar la muerte de su compañero. Para hacerlo, Freedman cuenta con un amplio elenco protagonizado principalmente por rostros conocidas del cine y la televisión como son Charles Bronson (''Hasta que llegó su hora'', ''La gran evasión''), Ed Harris (''Una mente maravillosa'', ''Gravity'') y Bruno Kirby (''Good morning, Vietnam'', ''Cuando Harry encontró a Sally'').

programme.title: Duelo en Diablo
programme.desc: El teniente McAllister (Bill Travers) recibe la orden de transportar un cargamento de munición a través de territorio apache, con tan sólo un pequeño destacamento de soldados novatos para protegerle. Les acompaña un antiguo explorador del ejército, Jess Remsberg (James Garner), y un exsoldado, Toller (Sidney Poitier), dedicado a la doma y suministro de caballos. Durante el viaje, Remsberg trata de localizar a Ellen Grange (Bibi Andersson), que fue secuestrada por los apaches y tras su liberación ha tratado de volver con ellos en repetidas ocasiones. Además, busca vengarse de los asesinos de su esposa, una mujer india.

programme.title: Patton
programme.desc: Tras unos pases vacilantes en el Norte de África, en los que el Afrika Corps logró derrotarle, el general George S. Patton toma revancha con la ayuda del General británico Montgomery expulsando a los nazis del África mediterránea. El general, querido por algunos y odiado por otros, se encamina entonces al corazón de la Alemania nazi para poner fin, junto al resto de los ejércitos aliados, al Tercer Reich. Ganadora de siete óscares, fue la absoluta triunfadora de la entrega de estos premios en el año 1971. Ganó todos los galardones importantes: mejor película, mejor director, mejor actor y mejor guion original. Y si ya pasó a la historia como una de las películas con más óscares en su haber, su entrada en los anales se debe también al hecho de que George C. Scott, el actor que encarna a Patton, rechazara el premio en uno de los pocos desplantes que los actores han hecho a Hollywood.

programme.title: La soga de la horca
programme.desc: J.D. Cahill es un reconocido abogado que, tras solucionar un caso muy difícil, vuelve a su ciudad donde se encuentra con otro peor. El sheriff y su ayudante han muerto en el atraco al banco local y el hijo mayor del estricto abogado está encarcelado por participar en el asalto.

programme.title: Estación Comanche
programme.desc: En el viejo Oeste se daba el nombre de comancheros a los aventureros que se dedicaban a rescatar prisioneros blancos, generalmente mujeres, en manos de los indios comanches, a cambio de una recompensa. Jeff Cody, un antiguo oficial del ejército, es un hombre que ha estado buscando a su mujer, cautiva en territorio indio durante muchos años. Llega a un campamento comanche y compra la libertad de una mujer blanca llamada Nancy Lowe y después la acompaña de vuelta para cobrar la recompensa de 5000 dólares que ofrece su marido John Lowe si la entrega sana y salva. Durante el regreso se une a la pareja un trío de cazadores desesperados por apoderarse también de la recompensa. Ben Lane, Frank y Dobbie, quienes pretenden arrebatarle la recompensa apoderándose de la mujer, después de coincidir con ellos en la estación comanche, parada de diligencias que constituye el punto clave de las comunicaciones por territorio indio, zona que conoce a la perfección Cody y no sus atacantes.

programme.title: Misioneros por el mundo
programme.desc: Programa que refleja la vida de varios misioneros españoles en el extranjero. Un equipo de reporteros se desplaza hasta los países de destino donde se encuentran los religiosos para convivir con ellos, adentrarse en sus vidas y conocer la realidad de cada lugar.

programme.title: Casablanca
programme.desc: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, Casablanca era una ciudad a la que llegaban huyendo del nazismo gentes de todas partes. Llegar era fácil, pero salir era casi imposible, especialmente si el nombre del fugitivo figuraba en las listas de la Gestapo. En esta ocasión, el principal objetivo de la policía secreta alemana es el líder checo y héroe de la resistencia, Victor Laszlo, cuya única esperanza es Rick Blaine, propietario del 'Rick's Café' y antiguo amante de su mujer, Ilsa. Cuando Ilsa se ofrece a quedarse, a cambio de un visado para sacar a Laszlo del país, Rick deberá elegir entre su propia felicidad o el idealismo que rigió su vida en el pasado.

programme.title: Hawai
programme.desc: A comienzos del siglo XIX, un joven príncipe hawaiano, estudiante de teología en Yale, lamenta el estado pagano en que se halla su gente y pide a los misioneros que viajen a Hawai para que lleven la luz del Cristianismo. Abner Hale (Max von Sydow), un joven y estricto reverendo de Nueva Inglaterra, acepta la llamada de la Iglesia. Con él viaja su reciente esposa, Jerusha Bromley (Julie Andrews), que accedió a casarse con él porque su otro pretendiente, Rafer Hoxworth (Richard Harris), no parecía decidido a pedir su mano. Globo de Oro a la mejor actriz secundaria (Jocelyne Lagarde) y mejor banda sonora (Elmer Bernstein). Candidata al Oscar en siete categorías.

programme.desc: Lorsque le corps d'une star de soap opera est retrouvé derrière une benne à ordures à Los Angeles, les détectives démêlent un complot sordide.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Les mamies voleuses
programme.desc: Les enquêteurs soupçonnent deux mamies d'être à l'origine d'une arnaque à l'assurance tordue, mais ils doivent trouver les preuves qui les relient à un délit de fuite.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: La vérité blesse
programme.desc: Une serveuse de cocktail de Miami raconte sa scandaleuse vérité dans un jeu télévisé et finit par mourir.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Coup de chance
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un millionnaire mexicain disparaît, un flic sous couverture fait en sorte que le coupable crache l'arme du crime.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Dissonance
programme.desc: À l'Opéra de Paris, un machiniste amoureux se met à jouer le rôle meurtrier du méchant.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Charmeur de serpent
programme.desc: Une star texane du rodéo est dévastée lorsqu'elle rentre chez elle et trouve sa femme, reine de beauté, morte avec de multiples morsures de serpent à sonnette aux pieds.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Mise en scène
programme.desc: Lorsque son mari la menace de divorce, une chasseuse de l'Arkansas met en scène un accident tragique qui est en fait un meurtre.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Mauvais pli
programme.desc: Une danseuse de ballet est matraquée à mort avec ses propres chaussons de danse, et les enquêteurs découvrent qu'une doublure corporelle studieuse attend dans les coulisses.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: Alors qu’il joue une partie de billard, Andre Daigle rencontre une belle et mystérieuse jeune femme. Ce soir-là, il disparaît.
